dashboard.name: G - Risques & Recommandations
dashboard.description: Alertes, risques détectés et recommandations associées. Utilise vw_recommendations.

cards.name: Risques par gravité
cards.query: SELECT severity, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM vw_recommendations GROUP BY severity ORDER BY cnt DESC;

cards.name: Recommandations par service
cards.query: SELECT service_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM vw_recommendations GROUP BY service_name ORDER BY cnt DESC;

cards.name: Détails recommandations (dernier 30 jours)
cards.query: SELECT recommendation_id, service_name, rule_id, text, status, created_at, severity, evidence FROM vw_recommendations WHERE created_at >= (current_date - INTERVAL '30 days') ORDER BY created_at DESC;

cards.name: KPI snapshot sample
cards.query: SELECT recommendation_id, (kpi_snapshot::text) AS kpi_snapshot FROM vw_recommendations WHERE kpi_snapshot IS NOT NULL LIMIT 10;
cards.notes: kpi_snapshot is JSONB; displayed as text for inspection
